description: This file contains factory functions for creating ViewModel instances within an Android application, specifically for note listing and editing features. It facilitates ViewModel creation without a dependency injection framework by providing custom ViewModelProvider.Factory implementations.

classes.name: ViewModelFactories
classes.description: A singleton object providing factory methods to instantiate ViewModels related to notes list and note editor, using repositories.

methods.name: notesList
methods.description: Creates a ViewModel factory for NotesListViewModel, injecting the given NotesRepository.

methods.name: noteEditor
methods.description: Creates a ViewModel factory for NoteEditorViewModel, injecting NotesRepository and noteId.
